long_biography.plain_text:
Juan Ignacio Entrecanales studied industrial engineering at Tufts University, completed an executive MBA in Madrid and entered Arthur Andersen as an auditor. ACCIONA hired him in 1994 for its construction operation. He moved from deputy management into executive leadership of the infrastructure business, directing its Polish expansion through Mostostal Warszawa and serving as chairman of the subsidiary.

The family succession of 2004 installed Entrecanales as group vice-chairman, while his cousin José Manuel took the chair. Under their direction, the inherited contractor was reshaped around transport infrastructure, renewable power and water services. His branch holds its family shares through Tussen de Grachten. Beyond ACCIONA, he presides over the Spanish Geographical Society and the Spain-India Council Foundation.
